title: Pair progress percentages with visual progress bars
summary: For each reported work item, show a numeric completion percentage together with a visual progress bar conveying the same value.
statement: For each reported work item, show a numeric completion percentage together with a visual progress bar conveying the same value.
rationale: Public-safe, scoped project-development requirement normalized from an independently authorized specimen.

conditions: A work item's completion is quantifiable from available evidence.
exceptions: Do not invent numerical precision when progress cannot be estimated.
